sources.title: Jordine/pantheon: A record of the models - GitHub
sources.snippet: Each model gets a page: Sources (official links, writing & commentary, tweets — dated, quoted verbatim) → Official record (release facts) → History (world-context and events) → Impressions (day-of and longitudinal vibes). Gaps are marked tk, not hidden. Contested events carry CONFIRMED / REPORTED / RUMOR tags. Not every model ever made — the ones with a character worth keeping.
